name: v0.3.18 — Item-card parity web + mobile · dual rating chips · value top-right
releaseNotes:
• Item-card layout is now identical web ↔ mobile, both driven by the central contract at test-fixtures/item-card-scenarios.json (21 scenarios). React ItemRowCard and Flutter FetchCard read the same spec; the dev showcase at /_dev/item-card lets you eyeball every variant against the PDF reference.
• Amount chip moved to top-right (was buried in the bottom utility row). Subtitle is one sentence: 'Bought ×N · last DATE · $X total'.
• Inline 5-star row replaced with compact rating chips. Personal rating shown as a single ★N pill — tap or long-press opens a 5-star bottom-sheet picker with a 'How worth it?' prompt. Community rating shown as a second ★X.X·count pill in indigo (avg across the user's own buys today; cross-user data later).
• Category pill swapped for an on-hand pill. Recategorize moved to the actions sheet's 'Change category' button so categorization is one tap away.
